description: Per-member and per–service-account Cursor cost and usage. Members from /teams/members; service accounts from usage events (service_account_id).

options.content:
- **Use case:** Cost and usage for one team member or service account (e.g. cloud agents).
- **Data source:** Cursor plugin — `_tool_cursor_usage_events`, `_tool_cursor_user_spend`, `_tool_cursor_members`.
- **Related:** [Cursor Usage & Cost](/d/cursor_usage-pg); [Cursor Enterprise AI Code & Insights](/d/cursor_enterprise-pg); [Cursor BugBot Review Analytics](/d/cursor_bugbot-pg).

panels.description: Total charged amount for billable usage events for the selected member in the selected time range (event_time).

targets.rawSql: SELECT CAST(COALESCE(SUM(charged_cents), 0) AS NUMERIC) / NULLIF(100, 0) AS "Charged Amount" FROM _tool_cursor_usage_events WHERE $__timeFilter(event_time) AND ('${connection_id}' = '' OR connection_id::text = '${connection_id}') AND scope_id = '${scope_id}' AND CASE WHEN service_account_id <> '' THEN 'sa:' || service_account_id ELSE user_email END = '${member}'

panels.title: Charged Amount

panels.description: On-demand (Usage-based) charged amount for the selected member in the selected time range.

targets.rawSql: SELECT CAST(COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN kind = 'Usage-based' THEN charged_cents ELSE 0 END), 0) AS NUMERIC) / NULLIF(100, 0) AS "On-Demand Amount" FROM _tool_cursor_usage_events WHERE $__timeFilter(event_time) AND ('${connection_id}' = '' OR connection_id::text = '${connection_id}') AND scope_id = '${scope_id}' AND CASE WHEN service_account_id <> '' THEN 'sa:' || service_account_id ELSE user_email END = '${member}'

panels.title: On-Demand Amount

panels.description: Average charged cost per usage event for the selected member in the selected time range.

targets.rawSql: SELECT CAST(COALESCE(CAST(SUM(charged_cents) AS NUMERIC) / NULLIF(NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 0), 0) AS NUMERIC) / NULLIF(100, 0) AS "Avg Cost / Event" FROM _tool_cursor_usage_events WHERE $__timeFilter(event_time) AND ('${connection_id}' = '' OR connection_id::text = '${connection_id}') AND scope_id = '${scope_id}' AND CASE WHEN service_account_id <> '' THEN 'sa:' || service_account_id ELSE user_email END = '${member}'

panels.title: Avg Cost / Event

panels.description: Days since the selected member's most recent usage event; green < 2d, yellow 2-6d, red >= 7d.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE((EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - MAX(event_time)))/86400), 9999) AS "Days Since Latest Event" FROM _tool_cursor_usage_events WHERE ('${connection_id}' = '' OR connection_id::text = '${connection_id}') AND scope_id = '${scope_id}' AND CASE WHEN service_account_id <> '' THEN 'sa:' || service_account_id ELSE user_email END = '${member}'

panels.title: Data Freshness

panels.description: Current billing-cycle fast premium requests for the selected member from /teams/spend, compared to a 500-request allocation. Green < 80%, yellow 80-99%, red >= 100%.

targets.rawSql: SELECT CASE WHEN '${member}' LIKE 'sa:%' THEN NULL ELSE COALESCE(MAX(fast_premium_requests), 0) END AS "Requests" FROM _tool_cursor_user_spend WHERE ('${connection_id}' = '' OR connection_id::text = '${connection_id}') AND scope_id = '${scope_id}' AND email = '${member}' AND billing_cycle_start = (SELECT MAX(billing_cycle_start) FROM _tool_cursor_user_spend WHERE ('${connection_id}' = '' OR connection_id::text = '${connection_id}') AND scope_id = '${scope_id}' AND ('${member}' LIKE 'sa:%' OR email = '${member}'))

panels.title: Premium Requests (of 500)

panels.description: Current billing-cycle on-demand spend for the selected member from /teams/spend (not filtered by dashboard time range).

targets.rawSql: SELECT CASE WHEN '${member}' LIKE 'sa:%' THEN (SELECT CAST(COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN kind = 'Usage-based' THEN charged_cents ELSE 0 END), 0) AS NUMERIC) / NULLIF(100, 0) FROM _tool_cursor_usage_events WHERE ('${connection_id}' = '' OR connection_id::text = '${connection_id}') AND scope_id = '${scope_id}' AND CASE WHEN service_account_id <> '' THEN 'sa:' || service_account_id ELSE user_email END = '${member}' AND event_time >= (SELECT MAX(billing_cycle_start) FROM _tool_cursor_user_spend WHERE ('${connection_id}' = '' OR connection_id::text = '${connection_id}') AND scope_id = '${scope_id}' AND ('${member}' LIKE 'sa:%' OR email = '${member}'))) ELSE (SELECT CAST(COALESCE(SUM(spend_cents), 0) AS NUMERIC) / NULLIF(100, 0) FROM _tool_cursor_user_spend WHERE ('${connection_id}' = '' OR connection_id::text = '${connection_id}') AND scope_id = '${scope_id}' AND email = '${member}' AND billing_cycle_start = (SELECT MAX(billing_cycle_start) FROM _tool_cursor_user_spend WHERE ('${connection_id}' = '' OR connection_id::text = '${connection_id}') AND scope_id = '${scope_id}' AND ('${member}' LIKE 'sa:%' OR email = '${member}'))) END AS "On-Demand Amount"

panels.title: On-Demand Amount

panels.description: Count of usage events for the selected member since the current billing cycle start (not filtered by dashboard time range).

targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS "Used Events" FROM _tool_cursor_usage_events WHERE ('${connection_id}' = '' OR connection_id::text = '${connection_id}') AND scope_id = '${scope_id}' AND CASE WHEN service_account_id <> '' THEN 'sa:' || service_account_id ELSE user_email END = '${member}' AND event_time >= (SELECT MAX(billing_cycle_start) FROM _tool_cursor_user_spend WHERE ('${connection_id}' = '' OR connection_id::text = '${connection_id}') AND scope_id = '${scope_id}' AND ('${member}' LIKE 'sa:%' OR email = '${member}'))

panels.title: Used Events

panels.description: Sum of input, output, cache-read, and cache-write tokens for the selected member since the current billing cycle start (not filtered by dashboard time range).

targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(input_tokens + output_tokens + cache_read_tokens + cache_write_tokens), 0) AS "Used Tokens" FROM _tool_cursor_usage_events WHERE ('${connection_id}' = '' OR connection_id::text = '${connection_id}') AND scope_id = '${scope_id}' AND CASE WHEN service_account_id <> '' THEN 'sa:' || service_account_id ELSE user_email END = '${member}' AND event_time >= (SELECT MAX(billing_cycle_start) FROM _tool_cursor_user_spend WHERE ('${connection_id}' = '' OR connection_id::text = '${connection_id}') AND scope_id = '${scope_id}' AND ('${member}' LIKE 'sa:%' OR email = '${member}'))

panels.title: Used Tokens

panels.description: Total charged usage for the selected member or service account since the current billing cycle start (sum of charged_cents on usage events). Compare to Cursor dashboard figures.

targets.rawSql: SELECT CAST(COALESCE(SUM(charged_cents), 0) AS NUMERIC) / NULLIF(100, 0) AS "Charged Since Cycle Start" FROM _tool_cursor_usage_events WHERE ('${connection_id}' = '' OR connection_id::text = '${connection_id}') AND scope_id = '${scope_id}' AND CASE WHEN service_account_id <> '' THEN 'sa:' || service_account_id ELSE user_email END = '${member}' AND event_time >= (SELECT MAX(billing_cycle_start) FROM _tool_cursor_user_spend WHERE ('${connection_id}' = '' OR connection_id::text = '${connection_id}') AND scope_id = '${scope_id}' AND ('${member}' LIKE 'sa:%' OR email = '${member}'))

panels.title: Charged Since Cycle Start

panels.description: Daily charged spend for the selected member, split by billing kind: on-demand (Usage-based) vs included (Included in Business).

targets.rawSql: SELECT CAST(event_time AS DATE) AS time, CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN kind = 'Usage-based' THEN charged_cents ELSE 0 END) AS NUMERIC) / NULLIF(100, 0) AS "On-Demand", CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN kind = 'Included in Business' THEN charged_cents ELSE 0 END) AS NUMERIC) / NULLIF(100, 0) AS "Included" FROM _tool_cursor_usage_events WHERE $__timeFilter(event_time) AND ('${connection_id}' = '' OR connection_id::text = '${connection_id}') AND scope_id = '${scope_id}' AND CASE WHEN service_account_id <> '' THEN 'sa:' || service_account_id ELSE user_email END = '${member}' GROUP BY CAST(event_time AS DATE) ORDER BY 1 NULLS FIRST

panels.title: Daily Spend

panels.description: Average cost per event, total charged, event count, tokens, and share of total events by model for the selected member.

targets.rawSql: SELECT model AS "Model", CAST(CAST(SUM(total_cents) AS NUMERIC) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS NUMERIC) / NULLIF(100, 0) AS "Avg Cost", CAST(SUM(charged_cents) AS NUMERIC) / NULLIF(100, 0) AS "Charged", COUNT(*) AS "Events", SUM(input_tokens + output_tokens + cache_read_tokens + cache_write_tokens) AS "Tokens", CAST(COUNT(*) * 100.0 AS NUMERIC) / NULLIF(SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (), 0) AS "Usage %" FROM _tool_cursor_usage_events WHERE $__timeFilter(event_time) AND ('${connection_id}' = '' OR connection_id::text = '${connection_id}') AND scope_id = '${scope_id}' AND CASE WHEN service_account_id <> '' THEN 'sa:' || service_account_id ELSE user_email END = '${member}' GROUP BY "model" ORDER BY SUM(charged_cents) DESC NULLS LAST

panels.title: Cost by Model

panels.description: Total charged spend by billing kind for the selected member in the selected period.

targets.rawSql: SELECT kind AS "Kind", CAST(SUM(charged_cents) AS NUMERIC) / NULLIF(100, 0) AS "Charged" FROM _tool_cursor_usage_events WHERE $__timeFilter(event_time) AND ('${connection_id}' = '' OR connection_id::text = '${connection_id}') AND scope_id = '${scope_id}' AND CASE WHEN service_account_id <> '' THEN 'sa:' || service_account_id ELSE user_email END = '${member}' GROUP BY "kind" ORDER BY SUM(charged_cents) DESC NULLS LAST

panels.title: Cost by Kind

panels.description: Recent chat sessions for the selected member, most recent first. Cursor usage events do not include a chat title, so Chat shows the session's latest model plus its last-event timestamp. Events with no conversation_id are grouped into a single (no session) row.

targets.rawSql: SELECT CASE WHEN t.session_id = '' THEN '(no session)' ELSE t.latest_model || ' · ' || TO_CHAR(CAST(t.last_event AS TIMESTAMP), '%b %e, YYYY HH24:MI') END AS "Chat", CAST(t.charged_cents AS NUMERIC) / NULLIF(100, 0) AS "Charged", t.events AS "Events", t.tokens AS "Tokens", t.last_event AS "Last Event" FROM (SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(conversation_id), ''), '') AS session_id, SUM(charged_cents) AS charged_cents, COUNT(*) AS events, SUM(input_tokens + output_tokens + cache_read_tokens + cache_write_tokens) AS tokens, MAX(event_time) AS last_event, SPLIT_PART(STRING_AGG(model, '||' ORDER BY event_time DESC NULLS LAST), '||', 1) AS latest_model FROM _tool_cursor_usage_events WHERE $__timeFilter(event_time) AND ('${connection_id}' = '' OR connection_id::text = '${connection_id}') AND scope_id = '${scope_id}' AND CASE WHEN service_account_id <> '' THEN 'sa:' || service_account_id ELSE user_email END = '${member}' GROUP BY COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(conversation_id), ''), '')) AS t ORDER BY t.last_event DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 25

panels.title: Cost by Chat Session

panels.description: Daily token volume for the selected member, broken into input, output, cache-read, and cache-write.

targets.rawSql: SELECT CAST(event_time AS DATE) AS time, SUM(input_tokens) AS "Input", SUM(output_tokens) AS "Output", SUM(cache_read_tokens) AS "Cache Read", SUM(cache_write_tokens) AS "Cache Write" FROM _tool_cursor_usage_events WHERE $__timeFilter(event_time) AND ('${connection_id}' = '' OR connection_id::text = '${connection_id}') AND scope_id = '${scope_id}' AND CASE WHEN service_account_id <> '' THEN 'sa:' || service_account_id ELSE user_email END = '${member}' GROUP BY CAST(event_time AS DATE) ORDER BY 1 NULLS FIRST

panels.title: Daily Token Trend

panels.description: Share of total tokens that came from cache reads for the selected member in the selected period. Higher cache-read share often means lower marginal cost.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(CAST(SUM(cache_read_tokens) * 100.0 AS NUMERIC) / NULLIF(NULLIF(SUM(input_tokens + output_tokens + cache_read_tokens + cache_write_tokens), 0), 0), 0) AS "Cache Read Share" FROM _tool_cursor_usage_events WHERE $__timeFilter(event_time) AND ('${connection_id}' = '' OR connection_id::text = '${connection_id}') AND scope_id = '${scope_id}' AND CASE WHEN service_account_id <> '' THEN 'sa:' || service_account_id ELSE user_email END = '${member}'

panels.title: Cache Read Share

panels.description: Share of usage events with Max Mode enabled for the selected member in the selected period.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN max_mode = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 AS NUMERIC) / NULLIF(NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 0), 0) AS "Max Mode Share" FROM _tool_cursor_usage_events WHERE $__timeFilter(event_time) AND ('${connection_id}' = '' OR connection_id::text = '${connection_id}') AND scope_id = '${scope_id}' AND CASE WHEN service_account_id <> '' THEN 'sa:' || service_account_id ELSE user_email END = '${member}'

panels.title: Max Mode Share

list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT connection_id FROM _tool_cursor_scopes ORDER BY connection_id NULLS FIRST
list.label: Connection ID
list.name: connection_id
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT connection_id FROM _tool_cursor_scopes ORDER BY connection_id NULLS FIRST

list.definition: SELECT id AS scope_id FROM _tool_cursor_scopes WHERE ('${connection_id}' = '' OR connection_id::text = '${connection_id}') ORDER BY id NULLS FIRST
list.label: Scope ID
list.name: scope_id
list.query: SELECT id AS scope_id FROM _tool_cursor_scopes WHERE ('${connection_id}' = '' OR connection_id::text = '${connection_id}') ORDER BY id NULLS FIRST

list.definition: SELECT __value, __text FROM (SELECT email AS __value, COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(name), ''), email) || ' <' || email || '>' AS __text, 0 AS sort_group, CASE WHEN LOWER(email) = LOWER('${__user.email}') THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS sort_ord, name AS sort_name FROM _tool_cursor_members WHERE ('${connection_id}' = '' OR connection_id::text = '${connection_id}') AND scope_id = '${scope_id}' AND is_removed = FALSE AND email <> '' UNION ALL SELECT 'sa:' || service_account_id AS __value, COALESCE(NULLIF(MAX(service_account_name), ''), service_account_id) || ' (Service Account)' AS __text, 1 AS sort_group, 2 AS sort_ord, MAX(service_account_name) AS sort_name FROM _tool_cursor_usage_events WHERE ('${connection_id}' = '' OR connection_id::text = '${connection_id}') AND scope_id = '${scope_id}' AND service_account_id <> '' GROUP BY service_account_id) AS actors ORDER BY sort_group NULLS FIRST, sort_ord NULLS FIRST, sort_name NULLS FIRST, __text NULLS FIRST
list.label: Member or service account
list.name: member
list.query: SELECT __value, __text FROM (SELECT email AS __value, COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(name), ''), email) || ' <' || email || '>' AS __text, 0 AS sort_group, CASE WHEN LOWER(email) = LOWER('${__user.email}') THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS sort_ord, name AS sort_name FROM _tool_cursor_members WHERE ('${connection_id}' = '' OR connection_id::text = '${connection_id}') AND scope_id = '${scope_id}' AND is_removed = FALSE AND email <> '' UNION ALL SELECT 'sa:' || service_account_id AS __value, COALESCE(NULLIF(MAX(service_account_name), ''), service_account_id) || ' (Service Account)' AS __text, 1 AS sort_group, 2 AS sort_ord, MAX(service_account_name) AS sort_name FROM _tool_cursor_usage_events WHERE ('${connection_id}' = '' OR connection_id::text = '${connection_id}') AND scope_id = '${scope_id}' AND service_account_id <> '' GROUP BY service_account_id) AS actors ORDER BY sort_group NULLS FIRST, sort_ord NULLS FIRST, sort_name NULLS FIRST, __text NULLS FIRST

title: Cursor Member Use
